description: Coverage mapping of external benchmark skill spaces against this suite. For each source benchmark: which skills are already exercised by existing tasks (tb2.1 competencies / v1 / tb3) and which gaps were closed by newly authored clean-room tasks. Source task CONTENT was never used in authoring — only neutral skill descriptions derived during inventory analysis; new tasks ship self-authored mini codebases (no upstream repos).

openthoughts-tblite.tasks_identical_note: 11 of 100 TBLite tasks are tb2.1 tasks themselves — covered by the tb2.1 competency inventory.

deepswe.profile: long-horizon feature implementations in real OSS repos (Go/Python/TS/Rust/JS); skills concentrated in language tooling (interpreters, linters, parsers/formatters, CLI/TUI frameworks), ORMs, HTTP internals, test harnesses, k8s manifest processing
